lines.name: 01-forgettable-gifts
lines.text: Stop buying forgettable gifts. Great gift givers follow five rules.

lines.name: 02-micro-friction
lines.text: One: solve a micro-friction. Replace the leaky bottle, frayed charger, or cold coffee mug.

lines.name: 03-small-luxury
lines.text: Two: buy the best version of something inexpensive, not the cheapest version of something expensive.

lines.name: 04-inside-callback
lines.text: Three: turn an inside joke into a physical callback.

lines.name: 05-permission-gift
lines.text: Four: give guilt-free permission for the hobby, facial, or experience they never buy themselves.

lines.name: 06-gift-notes
lines.text: Five: keep notes whenever someone mentions a want or annoyance. Don't ask, what should I buy. Ask, what friction or desire can I solve.
